red_evidence: Real exit-1 command returned Cancel instead of Continue. The target assertion fired, followed by runtime SIGABRT; not a complete failed-test summary.
behavior: Trusted synchronous command receives JSON and host-owned session/turn/model/tool/cwd/permission fields; missing session context is explicitly rejected.
Package and state directories are separate; symlink prefix escape rejected; real script verifies stdin/env/cwd and unchanged package directory.
PreToolUse handles exit 0/2/other, stop/deny and updatedInput. Rewritten tools are reauthorized by existing executor. PreModelRequest is observation-only.
Concurrent stdin/stdout/stderr and bounded 1MiB streams, timeout covers input writes; existing Unix process-group/Windows JobObject lifecycle is reused.

Additional context uses turn-owned buffer consumed by legacy and modern model paths; default 2500 approximate tokens, 0 disables spilling, full text retained with recovery path and UTF-8 head/tail preview.
limitations: Execution evidence is macOS only. Windows command/JobObject and Linux platform acceptance remain separate platform regression requirements; no claim of full cross-platform plugin compatibility.
Only previously admitted synchronous tool/model event bridge is covered; other events and async/MCP handlers remain explicit unsupported paths for subsequent tasks.

No external public service or GUI is required by this synchronous local-process story. Production model thread wiring is compile-checked; real-process protocol evidence is through the admitted handler boundary.
